# VM23G

> VM23G is a Singapore-based group blending executive business experience with certified expertise in Generative AI design and workflow automation. We design intelligent websites, applications, and operational systems for ambitious companies ready to scale with precision.

VM23G fuses fitness innovation, machine learning, and AI-enhanced coaching, including pose-recognition technology that studies movement data to improve form and performance. We build premium AI-driven systems for brands that refuse ordinary growth.

## Founders

- **Summan Misir Veera** — Founder, Managing Director. Elite sales instinct, commercial discipline, and high-conversion strategy. Leads brand direction, partnerships, and growth across the VM23G group.
- **Tinesh Awai Veera** — Co-Founder. 18+ years in nightlife, leadership, and revenue transformation, scaling venues from modest turnover to multimillion-dollar performance. Drives operational systems, AI-enhanced coaching, and movement intelligence.

## Capabilities

- Intelligent website and application design
- Generative AI workflow automation
- Pose-recognition and movement intelligence systems
- AI-enhanced coaching platforms (NavaFit Alignment)
- Brand and media architecture (AaVisions)
- Operational systems for high-growth brands
